5dn.text: Geth is the undead keeper of the Vault of Whispers, and when Glissa slaughters Yert's Reaper and wins his help, she defeats Geth's vampire and forces Geth to tell her what she wanted. Yert is then fed to the vampire, rises as a vampire and beheads Geth, who survives as a lich-head.

After Karn's return Geth becomes a guardian of the Mirari on a Memnite, and Karn gives the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth after destroying Memnarch's body. Geth's severed head also delivers Yert's demand for Glissa when Raksha's leonin ambush Vektro's goblin party.

som.text: After Glissa defeats Memnarch and disappears, Geth trudges back to Ish Sah in the Mephidross. He negotiates a deal with the Phyrexians, who graft his undead head onto a new Phyrexian metal body, seeing their advance as expedient for his own ends.

With Phyrexian support Geth wipes out rival challengers, reclaims the Vault of Whispers and builds a new army of nim, who bring offerings of metal that he uses to further Phyrexia's cause. When Venser teleports into the Black Lacuna, Geth attacks him as the Phyrexian army invades the surface.
Geth is later one of the seven Steel Thanes, rewarded with a new body for his complicity in the Phyrexian invasion, and the thanes carve out territories after claiming power during the war.
